headline: God of War Laufey cast and villains
title: God of War Laufey Cast and Villains | Jack Quaid, Kratos Returns, Sekhmet
video_script: God of War Laufey has a big cast. Jack Quaid voices Phranque, a curious cosmic cube who can't remember his past. Christopher Judge is back as Kratos, but as a non-playable character. And the villains are gods of war from other myths: Sekhmet from Egyptian mythology and Begtse from Mongolian mythology. It all happens in the Everywhen, where gods go after death. Who are you most excited to see? Comment below!
description: God of War Laufey cast: Jack Quaid as Phranque the cosmic cube, Christopher Judge returning as a non-playable Kratos, and villains Sekhmet (Egyptian) and Begtse (Mongolian). Set in the Everywhen.
